title: Leap to the Voice of Destiny!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOOH!! FINAL SPUUUUUURT!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Mmmph—!!
Mountain air feels incredible, doesn't it,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Huh, Trainer? Where'd you wander off to?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
To train our leg strength and stamina,
of course!
Besides,
the voice of destiny told me to push it to
the absolute limit!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even at summer training camp,
Epiphaneia was in top form.
Spurred on by the voice of destiny,
she'd suddenly go open-water swimming or
scale mountains on a whim.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The saving grace was that she never left me
behind,
always dragging me along for the ride.
choice_data_list: (...I've got to do whatever I can ...
(...I've got to do whatever I can ...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing how much she thrived training out in
raw nature,
I wanted to find her an even more effective
spot to build her strength—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With that thought in mind,
I pumped myself up and went scouting,
but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Embarrassingly enough,
I ended up completely lost deep in the
woods. My phone had no signal,
cutting off all communication.
What do I do—

text_block_list.name: Pack of Wild Dogs
text_block_list.text: (Grrrrrr...)
choice_data_list: (That growl... Don't tell me, a pa...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
What did you say?!
Trainer hasn't come back yet?!

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I was sure they were with you,
but...
We might need to send out a search party.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Then I'm going!! —...That way!

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Huh?!
That way...?
How could you possibly know that?!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I just know!
Trainer is—my destiny, after all!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Even when we first met,
I felt it pulling me: "Over here!"
I can hear it right now!
There's no way I could be wrong...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOAAAAHHH!! Hold on, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Pack of Wild Dogs
text_block_list.text: (Snarl... Grrrr...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cold, clammy sweat dripped down my cheek.
The distance closing between me and the
pack
was definitely not my imagination—
I was being cornered like prey.
choice_data_list: (—A cliff?! Crap, it's a dead end—)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: —FOUND YOU!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Just as I thought! You really were here,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An unmistakable voice echoed from below the
cliff.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Any wonder as to how she found me vanished
in an instant.
"Just as I thought"—she had heard me.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Hang tight! I'm heading up right now!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'm relieved she found me,
but I can't put her in danger.
Unable to shout,
I frantically shake my head and make an X
with my arms.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Huh? Why "no"? What's—

text_block_list.name: Vicious Pack of Stra...
text_block_list.text: (GRRRRRRR!!)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
! I get it, a pack of wild dogs, huh...?
In that case—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
There's only one choice!
Jump down, Trainer! I'll catch you,
I swear!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry!
I'll never—never let go of my destiny!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Come on, Trainer! Fall into my arms!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There's no time to hesitate—no,
seeing her outstretched hands clears all
doubt.
I promised to follow her until the day
destiny fills the world.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without hesitation,
I kick off the ground and leap into the
air.
—Everything seems to move in slow motion.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: —Gotcha!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: You hurt anywhere, Trainer?
choice_data_list: No, though my legs turned to jelly...
No, though my legs turned to jelly...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
Catching one of you is a piece of cake.
I could do it a hundred times!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Fsshhhh... BOOM! BOOM! BOOM!)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Fireworks...!
Come to think of it,
the fireworks festival was tonight.
choice_data_list: You missed them because of me... S...
You missed them because of me... S...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: ? What are you talking about? Whoa—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Effortlessly lifting me in a bridal carry,
Epiphaneia dashes through the night.
Without a hint of hesitation,
straight ahead—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Who cares about fireworks...?!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Look! The stars are shining so brightly!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I catch my breath at the breathtaking view
unfolding before me.
She always radiates an explosive brilliance,
setting my heart racing—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A radiant comet blazing right at the center
of the starlit sky.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: —Ah, that look!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
It's the same look you gave me when you
said,
"I'm really glad to be spending time with
you!" Yes! I get to see it again!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ever since then,
I've wanted to see so many more of your
expressions!
I knew there had to be so many faces where
we felt the exact same way!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
When you're having fun, when you're surprised,
when you're flustered. I love them all!
But above all—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
This face...
the one you're making right now is my absolute
favorite!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Hey—what are you feeling right now?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I want to bring that look to your face over
and over again.
Tell me, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I reflect back on both moments.
Back then and right now, surely—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: —!! A happy face!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I see...! So that's why
I was drawn to that expression so much!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
My existence brought you happiness—
Of course I'd want to see that as many times
as possible!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!!
That face full of happiness,
and all your other faces too!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Show me more and more of them from now on!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'll probably be swept along by her whirlwind
pace plenty more times,
with plenty of hardship ahead. And yet...
I still want to keep following her into the
future.
choice_data_list: (—I want to witness the comet's br...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The brilliance of the starlit summer night
is etched into my memory,
and I know it will never fade away.
